turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm reviewing the draft of the 'Advanced Cluster Computing' manual. Can you check if the section on hardware specs is consistent?
Sure, Alan. I can review the hardware specs section. Do you have the current draft uploaded or can you paste the relevant text?
I just updated the table of contents. Just so you know for context, WFM currently includes a chapter on 4-GPU acceleration.
Got it. I'll note that the current scope covers 4-GPU acceleration. Is there anything specific you want me to verify in the text?
No, just keeping the context. Also, did my package for the new monitor stand arrive?
Let me check your recent orders. I don't see a delivery confirmation yet for the monitor stand. It might still be in transit.
Ugh, okay. Thanks for checking. I'll wait.
You're welcome. I'll let you know if I see any updates on the tracking status.
Lloyd, we need to update the marketing blurb for the manual. The hardware section has been revised.
Understood. What specific changes were made to the hardware section?
We expanded the scope. WFM now includes a chapter on 8-GPU acceleration.
Noted. I've updated the context for WFM to reflect the 8-GPU acceleration chapter. Does this change affect the pricing tier?
No, pricing stays the same. Just need the blurb to highlight the new capability.
I can draft a few bullet points emphasizing the expanded hardware support. Would you like me to focus on performance metrics?
Yes, please. Also, is it going to rain this weekend?
The forecast shows a high chance of rain on Saturday and Sunday. I'd suggest bringing an umbrella if you're planning to go out.
